Hello,

I saw TwoDo's opening for a Visual Designer and wanted to apply, especially given your focus on building cohesive visual identities for startups and established brands alike.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have designed over 100 digital and print creatives while building reusable templates that reduced turnaround time. Before that, I developed complete brand identity systems and startup assets at AT Creation.

You can see my brand identity work in the AT Creation startup branding kit on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/, which demonstrates my approach to creating clear visual systems.

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Pune for this on-site role. Could we take five minutes next week to discuss how my background fits your studio?

Ananya
